title: Exclude coordination leases from private Git history
changes: Exclude transient coordination lease directories from new versioned debug sessions while keeping selected debug artifacts visible to Git.
Document private session placement, copied save visibility and the exclusion of coordination leases.
validation: Eleven Linux isolated-session tests passed, including Git status checks for root and nested synthetic lease markers.
Synthetic Git add checks using all four private worktree rules excluded leases and ROM filenames while retaining debug saves, snapshots and inputs.
limitations: Existing sessions retain their earlier ignore files; real active or interrupted leases were not modified. Native Windows was not tested.
